lesson: Easy heldout evidence metrics can hide a capacity need that appears only on stricter causal relation-only tests. The compact specialist looked nearly tied on ordinary graph dev but fell far behind the expanded specialist on relation-essential pair flips.
reusable_rule: Do not infer that extra capacity is useless from an evaluation that does not isolate the capability the capacity is meant to support.

lesson: Directed relation reasoning needs explicit endpoint roles. A graph read that scores mainly relation targets can learn many ordinary evidence tasks yet fail root-cause, correction-direction, and temporal-direction queries.
reusable_rule: Represent source and target roles separately for directed relations; keep genuinely symmetric relations symmetric.

lesson: Counterfactual edge-drop metrics are weak when node text independently reveals the answer. Same-text/same-query paired graph flips provide a cleaner causal test of whether topology is actually used.
reusable_rule: When testing graph dependence, hold text and query fixed and change only graph structure whenever possible.

lesson: Frozen evaluation rows must not become repair training data. Use independent analogues with the same abstract relation skill and keep the frozen set for the final decision.
reusable_rule: Failure-driven repair should reproduce the capability requirement, not copy the evaluation instances.

lesson: When a specialist representation already solves ordinary evidence selection, freeze it during a narrowly diagnosed relation-read repair and replay the original task to protect retained capability.
reusable_rule: Localize gradient scope to the diagnosed bottleneck before considering another broad retrain.
